name: @spacetrash/desktop
description: SpaceTrash desktop app — scan, classify, confirm-to-act
author: SpaceTrash

scripts.dist:win: npm run bundle && node scripts/pack-native.mjs electron && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never && node scripts/pack-native.mjs node
scripts.dist:mac: npm run bundle && node scripts/pack-native.mjs electron && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never && node scripts/pack-native.mjs node
scripts.dist:linux: npm run bundle && node scripts/pack-native.mjs electron && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never && node scripts/pack-native.mjs node
